body:
Marking [#14](https://github.com/dpep/inkling/pull/14) ready pushed `state draft → open` into the session that ran `gh pr ready`, and merging it pushed `open → merged` fifteen seconds later: two turns telling a session what it had just done. Earlier PRs cost one only because ready and merge fell in the same poll and read `draft → merged`.

## What changed

- **Out of draft is a start, so it isn't pushed.** [`push::worth_a_turn`](https://github.com/dpep/inkling/blob/06516e3/src/push.rs#L92) already held back `checks → pending` for the same reason; `state draft → open` joins it. It stays in `inkling events`, and the verdict that follows passes over it. Ready then merge now costs one push whether GitHub reports it in one poll or two ([test](https://github.com/dpep/inkling/blob/06516e3/src/push.rs#L573)). `draft → merged`, `draft → closed` and going *back* to draft are still pushed.
- **Events are kept for 72h, and watches last 72h by default** (separate final commit, droppable). [`WATCH_TTL`](https://github.com/dpep/inkling/blob/b4d1970/src/adapters/watches_json.rs#L48) is defined as [`RETENTION`](https://github.com/dpep/inkling/blob/b4d1970/src/adapters/watches_json.rs#L41); the post-tool hook uses it, and a [test](https://github.com/dpep/inkling/blob/b4d1970/src/main.rs#L2378) holds clap's `--ttl` default to it.

## Rejected: withholding pushes from the session that caused the change

Reasoning is in [docs/watching.md, "Your own actions"](https://github.com/dpep/inkling/blob/b4d1970/docs/watching.md#your-own-actions-arrive-as-news-and-that-stays). The main reason, measured on the probe repo with gh 2.94 off a TTY (how Claude Code runs Bash): `gh pr merge 3 --repo …` prints **nothing**, and `gh pr ready 3` prints `owner/repo#3`, not a URL. The post-tool hook only reads references from URLs, so a self-merge would be suppressed or not depending on how the command was spelled. What's left once ready is withheld is one line per self-merged PR, and for `--auto` or a merge queue that line is real news. Subagents share the parent's session id, so "self" would have covered them too. The doc also used to say `gh pr merge` returns before GitHub finishes. That was wrong, and the doc now says so.

## Proof, end to end

Debug build, scratch `--config/--state/--watches/--log-dir`, a Python listener standing in for the session socket. Draft PR opened on dpep/inkling-ci-probe (#4). A fake `post-tool` payload (`gh pr create` + URL) registered the watch, then `gh pr ready`, and two ticks later `gh pr merge`:

```
03:03:32 transition … inkling-ci-probe#4 axis="state" from="draft" to="open" seq=1 audience=1
03:04:18 transition … inkling-ci-probe#4 axis="state" from="open" to="merged" seq=2 audience=1
03:04:18 pushed subscriber="lane-self-e2e" seq=2 outcome="written"
```

The listener got exactly one message, `inkling: github.com/dpep/inkling-ci-probe#4 state open → merged`. `inkling events --since lane-self-e2e:0` still listed both transitions.

## Dogfood

`inkling wait --until checks` (installed build) ran in the background, started a few seconds after `gh pr create`. It waited through the gap before the first rollup this time, with no false preclude, and exited 0 at 1m 2s (5 polls) with `success github.com/dpep/inkling#16`. I could act on that without looking anything else up. The push leg went to the parent session, since the post-tool hook registered #16 there when this subagent ran `gh pr create`. I can't see what arrived there. That's for the parent to report. The new rule only reaches sessions after `make install`, so no push on this PR has run through it. The scratch run above is what exercised it.

Vibed with Claude Code.
